title: senna spectabilis var. excelsa
intro: Senna spectabilis var. excelsa, commonly known as the Queensland senna or Australian bloodroot, is a plant species in the Fabaceae family. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat a range of health issues, including constipation, diarrhea, and skin conditions, thanks to its health benefits in stimulating bowel movements, reducing inflammation, and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Senna spectabilis var. excelsa include its laxative and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to relieve constipation and reduce pain and swelling in the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include anthraquinone glycosides, such as aloe-emodin and chrysophanol, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
